text:
vivian_csm: Quick 20m at 3pm PT to kick off StrataCare onboarding. Goals: owners, must-have success criteria, timeline, and any immediate renewal or compliance flags. Who's available?
oscar_pm: I2m in. I'll own product acceptance and final sign-off.
tess_enable: I can run the enablement + demo. Proposed must-haves: e2e call flow, embeddings sanity checks, Console access for ops, and a 1-page feedback capture.
ben_se: I'll prep sample payloads and a minimal canary. Heads-up: StrataCare asked about Canadian data residency and an air-gapped option for PHI. Need clarification whether pilot must be in CAN region.
hao_eng: SSO is GA-only; ETA ~7 business days. For pilot we can do token auth. If Canada residency required for pilot, that'll add ~2 weeks for infra; flagging that as a timeline risk.
kira_csm: Renewal watch: contract renewal in ~11 months. Recommend capturing usage and value metrics by month 2; plan an interim exec readout at month 7.
vivian_csm: Proposed timeline: smoke tests within 72h, internal pilot next week, customer pilot in 14 days if no residency blocker.
oscar_pm: Action items: @ben_se -> samples + README to s3://stratacare/samples by tomorrow 11:00; @hao_eng -> confirm Canada infra feasibility and SSO ticket ETA; @tess_enable -> schedule 30m enablement + create 4-question feedback survey. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
tess_enable: Scheduling now. Plan: 15m demo + 15m Qs. I'll post Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/stratacare-onboard (WIP) and the survey link here after demo.
calendar-bot: Event created: "StrataCare onboarding kickoff" at 15:00 PT. Attendees: vivian_csm, oscar_pm, tess_enable, ben_se, hao_eng, kira_csm.
ben_se: :thumbsup: I'll include curl + python snippets in the README and a tiny load test (5rps) for canary.
hao_eng: Logged risks: "CAN_residency" and "SSO_delay". Fallbacks: hosted token-based pilot or partial dataset blackout for PHI. Also adding ticket for DPA request.
kira_csm: I'll create a renewal risk scorecard and add initial health signals to the ticket.
vivian_csm: Draft acceptance checklist (will formalize in Confluence):
```
- smoke_tests: pass
- p95_latency < 350ms
- embedding_spotcheck >= 0.92
- console_access: granted
- residency_flag_resolved
- week1_usage_reported
```
oscar_pm: Also ensure monitoring alerts, cost baseline, and fallback model pinned before pilot.
tess_enable: After enablement I'll post a 1-paragraph summary + survey link. Plan daily 10m standups for the first 5 business days to triage issues and surface feedback.
vivian_csm: I'll send a 1-pager to the exec sponsor and kick off the standup series. Thanks team :rocket:
